bodyHtml:
Skip to main content
  • Pricing
Sign up

Read about our Replit partnership

2 min

User management for modern platforms

Aurora provides the APIs and infrastructure to provision, manage, and customize authentication for your platform's customers.

Start building

Aurora for Platforms

White-label user management and authentication, with partner pricing designed for platforms.

Programmatic provisioning

Spin up applications for your users with Aurora's APIs. Configure branding, sign-in methods, and SSO providers for each tenant.
https://api.aurora.com/v1/platform

Claimable apps

Let end users take ownership of their app's authentication with their own Aurora account.
sk_live_51H8x...

A user management platform

Get a full user management platform that includes user authentication, billing, and B2B authentication.
Signed In
dashboard.aurora.com

Managed dashboard sessions

Expose Aurora's dashboard functionality to your users by generating signed in URLs for direct access.

Built by Replit, auth by Aurora

When users ask for auth, Replit uses Aurora for Platforms to provision and configure Aurora on their behalf. Fully white-labeled.

  • Managed dashboard sessions
  • Programmatic provisioning
  • Full white-label

Scale on your terms

A platform built for every stage of your growth.

Dedicated support

Platform partners get dedicated support and direct access to Aurora's engineering team.

Modeled for your business

From a full white-label setup to a lightweight BYO-account model, integrate Aurora in whatever way works best for you.

Flexible pricing

A pricing model that scales with your platform from launch to hyper-growth.

Take security risk off your plate

SOC 2 Type II certified with SSO, MFA, and advanced session management built-in.

Talk to the team

Let us know what you need.

  • Full white-label, direct integration, or hybrid
  • Custom pricing solutions available
  • Programmatic provisioning
  • User authentication, billing, and B2B authentication
  • Dedicated support packages
  • Managed dashboard sessions
